values: Clear skies today; travel should be easier.
You look rushed. Is there something you need to handle soon?
The village has been unusually peaceful lately. Rare, truly rare.
I was about to rest for a bit before continuing.
Everything is fine, just a little busy.
Not bad. Nothing major has happened today.
I heard a new stream of spiritual energy has gathered near the forest edge.
If you go early, you may find spirit herbs before others pick them clean.
Monster tracks have appeared near the mountain edge lately. Do not go alone.
I still remember what happened last time.
Do not think I have forgotten that debt.
Push me too far again and I will not endure it.
I still remember what you mentioned last time.
You seem less busy today than yesterday.
Tell me if you hear any new information later.
The fields are still damp today; starting early should be fine.
With weather like this, the spirit rice should grow well.
For farmers, timely rain matters more than anything.
Yes, fieldwork cannot be rushed too much.
I still need to check a few things along the field ridge.
If I finish early today, I can still trade some goods.
Ask directly if you want to see anything.
Goods are not lacking today; quick buyers are.
If you have something valuable, I am ready to trade.
This price is already fair; I cannot lower it much more.
A finished trade leaves both sides at ease.
Give and take; next time I will keep a better price for you.
First time meeting you. I hope we can talk again later.
Passing through here is already a kind of fate. Let us at least remember each other.
I will remember your face. I should recognize you next time.
Yes, let us get acquainted slowly.
Rest assured, fellow Daoist. I am not hard to talk to.
Meeting here is also a kind of fate.
{1}, I have heard villagers mention you a few times. Now that we meet, your aura seems steadier than the rumors suggested. You are not merely someone who talks big.
{1}, this is our first meeting, but I noticed your steps from afar. Most people rush through here, while you keep a steady distance. You must be used to traveling outside.
{1}, if we pass the forest edge together in the future, call me. Staying alive alone is easy, but facing real danger with someone trustworthy is better.
{1}, I will remember your words. Around here, knowing one more person who keeps faith is worth more than finding a few Spirit Stones.
{1}, if either of us hears news about spirit herbs, monsters, or strange mountain paths, we should tell each other first. Better to move slowly than rush into death.
{1}, I do not like shallow connections either. Today we remember each other; later, real events will show who is trustworthy.
{1}, last time you mentioned spiritual energy gathering near the stream. I passed by and the soil really was softer than usual. Spirit herbs may grow there in a few days.
{1}, I am still thinking about what you said before. If that information is true, we should go early before too many people arrive.
{1}, you seem less hurried lately. Did your state of mind settle after the last battle?
I once thought cultivation alone was enough. Later I learned that reading people also matters.
After traveling far, I realized that staying alive is also a skill.
Sometimes sitting quietly and observing for a day teaches more than running everywhere.
That makes sense. Sometimes slowing down is how you see things clearly.
I understand. Some matters only become worse when rushed.
Talking with you is not bad. At least it does not waste time.
{1}, that level {3} {2} over there is looking at us like food. Shall we strike first and keep some dignity as cultivators?
{1}, that level {3} {2} just roared very rudely. I propose we act on behalf of heaven and see if it drops anything valuable.
{1}, if I say the plan is still fine later, it means you should run first. For now, shall we deal with this level {3} {2}?
{1}, that level {3} {2} has been standing there too long. It does not cultivate, pay taxes, or stop scaring travelers. I see plenty of reason to hit it.
{1}, that level {3} {2} has been lingering near the road. Charging alone is reckless, but if we pressure it from both sides, our chance to bring it down is much better.
{1}, I found traces of a level {3} {2}. We should not let it approach the village. If you still have spiritual power, we can call others and strike before dusk.
{1}, that level {3} {2} will not be easy. But if it learns the scent of people here, villagers gathering herbs will suffer. Will you try this fight with me?
{1}, fine, but if that level {3} {2} opens its mouth too wide, I will prioritize my Dao heart and my legs.
{1}, I will come. If we win, we split the spoils. If we lose, we split directions and run.
{1}, sounds reasonable. I will handle attacking; you handle making sure I am not hit too much.
{1}, let us try. At worst, today we gain a deep understanding of the words know your limits.
{1}, I dislike meaningless risks, but that level {3} {2} is indeed a threat. Let us check the escape route first, then strike.
{1}, good. I will keep distance on the left. Do not chase too deep. If the level {3} {2} turns toward the village, stop it immediately.
{1}, calling one more person would be better. Fighting strong monsters is not about showing courage; it is about surviving to bring news back.
{0} watched the level {2} {1} fall and sighed in relief: "Good. I almost had to use my secret art of running very fast."
{0} straightened their robe: "This victory was pure skill. Any trembling hands were caused by spiritual energy fluctuations."
{0} looked around: "Did anyone see that? If not, I can add some grandeur when I retell it later."
{0} muttered: "After defeating a level {2} {1}, eating an extra bowl tonight is not too much."
{0} brought down the level {2} {1}. The fight looked short, but half a breath slower and its claws would have reached the heart.
{0} exhaled while looking at the fallen level {2} {1}: "If this thing had entered the spirit rice fields, the whole village would lose sleep. Good thing it was stopped."
{0} wiped blood from their hand: "A level {2} {1} is no weak foe. Next time we see tracks like that, we must warn everyone earlier."
{1}, your timing was perfect. I was about to say save me, but you moved first and preserved my dignity.
{1}, good coordination. If anyone asks, say we planned it all from the start. Do not mention the part where I backed away a little too fast.
{1}, that level {3} {2} was strong. Luckily it never knew we were fighting while praying not to miss.
{1}, this battle is worth remembering. Keep the record short, though. Leave out the part where I almost fell.
{1}, your block just now was exactly right. Without that timing, the level {3} {2} would have escaped into the forest.
{1}, our coordination was not bad. The level {3} {2} was stronger than expected, but it could not withstand pressure from both sides.
{1}, remember the roar of that level {3} {2}. If you hear it from afar next time, do not stand alone on the mountain road.
{1}, do not worry. I will describe your three steps back as a tactic to lure the enemy.
{1}, victory is enough. The cultivation world remembers results, not running posture.
{1}, I will fight with you again next time, but eat first. I do not want your stomach to roar louder than {2}.
{1}, if the loot is small, we call it protecting the people. If it is large, we call it shared fate.
{1}, your contribution was not small. Without you drawing it aside, I would not have had space to strike.
{1}, I thought we might have to retreat. Now that the level {3} {2} is down, we should leave before the smell of blood draws more monsters.
{1}, coordination like that is trustworthy. If we meet stronger monsters later, at least I know whose back I can trust.
This morning I tried to comprehend the Dao under a tree. I realized I should have eaten breakfast first.
The village is so peaceful that I suspect some great event is being too lazy to happen.
I saw someone stare at the sky for three watch periods. They must have been waiting for fate to fall straight into their mouth.
Fellow Daoist, have you noticed? Every time I decide to cultivate diligently, the tavern smells dangerously persuasive.
The village is fairly peaceful today.
You looked busy when I passed by. Is everything fine?
Tell me if you hear any new news.
I will take {0}; here are {1} Spirit Stones.
This is exactly what I needed. Thanks.
This price works. The trade is done.
Sold {0} and received {1} Spirit Stones.
Good item. Use it carefully.
Smooth trade. Come again next time.
{1} Spirit Stones for {0} is too low.
This item cannot be sold that cheaply.
If you are sincere, offer a little more.
Do not force me to risk my life!
Today I will fight you with everything I have!
If you want to live, move aside!
Since I have struck, do not blame me for being heavy-handed.
You dare attack me?
I will not endure this anymore!
Do not think I am easy to bully!
If you want a fight, I will see it through.
Thirty years east of the river, thirty years west; {1}, never look down on a poor youth!
{1}, today you rely on a higher realm to pressure me. When I break through, I will stand at your door and cough three times so you understand.
So what if my realm is low? So what if I have few Spirit Stones? My Dao heart may be poor, but it is very hard.
{1}, you hit me today. In my future memoir, your name will definitely appear in the villain chapter.
Do not think Qi Refining is easy to bully. I am merely collecting humiliation to give my future breakthrough more momentum!
A gentleman can wait ten years for revenge. A poor cultivator may need longer, but I am keeping records!
{1}, just wait. Today I step back half a pace not from fear, but to give the Great Dao more room to develop.
I swear to heaven, if I survive this, the first thing I do is cultivate. The second is avoid you for a few days.
You are several stages above me and still attack. Are you not ashamed? Ah, I forgot, powerful people often cultivate away their shame first.
Do not despise me for lacking fate now. Maybe tomorrow I find a manual, the next day a master, and the day after that I return to settle accounts!
Not good. I must preserve my life first!
My HP is low. Retreat first!
Only the living have another chance!
This battle is too dangerous. I cannot keep risking it.
The weather is pleasant today.
A light breeze like this makes travel comfortable.
Stable weather makes work smoother.
Yes, today is suitable for going out to work.
Clear skies like this rarely make anyone unhappy.
It would be nice if every day were this mild.
Rain is falling. The spirit rice fields should improve.
The road is slippery. Be careful if you travel far.
This rain softens the spiritual energy.
Yes, today is better for work near the village.
Moderate rain is good. Let us hope it does not become a storm.
I also think the spirit fields needed this rain.
The thunder is fierce. Do not go to the forest edge right now.
When thunder rises, monsters often become more violent.
The sound of thunder makes the heart uneasy.
I was planning to avoid the mountain road today as well.
Caution is better. Wait until the sky calms.
If there is something urgent, bring someone with you.
Snow is falling. Walk slowly.
Snow days are rare. The village looks completely different.
It is cold. Keep your spiritual power stable.
Yes, the snow is beautiful, but travel is harder.
I will return early to avoid the cold qi.
A day like this suits rest more than errands.
Spiritual energy is thickening. Today is good for cultivation.
Can you feel it? The aura here is stronger.
If you want to break through, you should prepare today.
I was also planning to find a quiet place to cultivate.
A good chance should not be wasted.
Spiritual energy like this is rare.
I am a little hungry. I should find something to eat later.
My stomach is growling. Even work feels slower.
Is there anywhere in the village still selling food?
Eat first. Work can wait.
I saw food near the market.
Do not get so hungry that you faint on the road.
I am truly tired today. I should rest early.
After working all day, my body feels heavy.
Perhaps I should go home and rest for a while.
Rest. Forcing yourself too much ruins things.
Preserving strength is also a form of cultivation.
I am nearby. Call if you need anything.
I am short on resources and need to find more.
Materials have been used up quickly lately.
If you see good spirit herbs, remember to tell me.
I heard spirit herbs sometimes appear near the stream.
If you search for resources, avoid monster areas.
If I have spare materials, I will keep you in mind.
My cultivation is too slow. I must train harder.
My state of mind has been stuck lately, making progress difficult.
If there is a suitable pill, I would like to try it once.
Do not rush. A stable foundation lets you go farther.
When you have time, choose a place with steady spiritual energy.
I heard good pills must be used at the right moment.
